en.text: For “He who would love life And see good days, Let him refrain his tongue from evil, And his lips from speaking deceit. Let him turn away from evil and do good; Let him seek peace and pursue it.

es.text: Porque: El que quiere amar la vida Y ver días buenos, Refrene su lengua de mal, Y sus labios no hablen engaño; Apártese del mal, y haga el bien; Busque la paz, y sígala.
